description: This file defines a report for job card summaries in an ERP system, including data retrieval, chart data preparation, and column configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves job card data and associated time logs, processes statuses and times.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data for visualizing open vs completed job cards over time.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Generates labels and periodic data counts for charting based on date ranges.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table, including conditional columns based on filters.
